customPresets: Replace the compaction-basic provider with @missher/dsh-context-manager/engine explicitly. Saved preset overrides take precedence.

runtimeCapabilities.idleMaintenanceSelection: Plugin-owned selection inside Agent.runMaintenance; no Basic selection hook required
runtimeCapabilities.protectedToolPruning: toolResultPruner.supportsProtectedSeqs === true and an open turn in the session log; idle/manual maintenance skips tool-result pruning and retains checkpoint summaries
runtimeCapabilities.durableMetadata: Existing storageDomain schemas plus a plugin-owned pending metadata journal; no session/learning migration
runtimeCapabilities.summaryAbortCommit: Plugin-owned transaction checks AbortSignal immediately before synchronous Session replacement
runtimeCapabilities.storageShutdownDrain: Writable profileContext.dir/.context-manager-recovery journal; Host registerDrain used when available. Custom embedding without profile path requires Host drain.
runtimeCapabilities.journalDurability: Mandatory regular-file fsync on every platform; POSIX directory fsync, Windows published-file O_RDWR fsync after rename. Failure refuses writes; no power-loss or network-filesystem guarantee. Windows ACL inherited from profile.
runtimeCapabilities.workingSet: Automatic recent-history preference plus bounded checkpoint, with whole tool groups, protected instructions and complete pressure validation; custom total caps optional.
runtimeCapabilities.cycleAccounting: Legacy context_manager_cycles v1 is read only. New context_manager_operations atomically consumes the unified 2-primary/4-total budget and optional exact one-shot authorization; back up both. Manual calls also consume permits. Unknown remains blocked across restart. Older runtimes cannot enforce the new domain; disable automatic compaction before a coordinated downgrade.
runtimeCapabilities.historyRead: Optional tools/sessionQuery/sessions: bounded read-only original text lookup in the executing agent session; no vectors or network.
runtimeCapabilities.toolResultReduction: Reduction runs through the Host's final tool-result seam and publishes only a verified short value; the reducer never rewrites another plugin's bytes. A reference counts as confirmed only when the final Host result still carries the short text; pending/reverted stay separate and character deltas are not billing.
runtimeCapabilities.originalArchive: Profile-local .context-manager-archive with durable outcome rows, cross-restart rebuild and physical quota reconciliation; every read path is read-only. Retention is unconditional: no purge action, no retention switch, and uninstalling never deletes it.
runtimeCapabilities.usageAttribution: attributeSession folds the current immutable cut and keeps the Host tokenUsage projection authoritative when present; the four buckets stay mutually exclusive. Partial samples yield a labelled known lower bound, all-unknown yields unknown, and the summary ledger stays one undivided figure because it has no durable purpose field.
runtimeCapabilities.forkInheritedOriginals: A forked session may read back only the originals granted inside its inherited prefix, bounded by boundary validity, reference count, scanned events and a total-log cap checked before the observation is materialised.
